_comment: Expected Devin Desktop output for canonical/full-featured.json. Conversions: (1) before_tool_execute+shell -> PreToolUse with matcher 'exec'; (2) before_tool_execute+mcp -> PreToolUse with matcher 'mcp__github__create_issue' (same MCP format as Claude Code); (3) session_start -> SessionStart with no matcher. Timeout stays in seconds. Devin hook entries carry only type, command, and timeout, so platform/cwd/env are dropped. provider_data.devin is dropped: its show_output and working_directory keys have no field in Devin's hook format.
_warnings: Hook 1: devin hooks support only type, command, and timeout; cwd, env, platform, async, and statusMessage dropped
